com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class AIConfigDefault

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AIConfigDefault
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    AIAgentConfigDefault, AICompletionConfigDefault, AIJudgeConfigDefault

    public abstract class AIConfigDefault
extends java.lang.Object
    The common, mode-independent surface of a caller-supplied default AI Config.

    A default is passed to an LDAIClient retrieval method and is returned (as the corresponding concrete config type) when the flag is absent or cannot be evaluated. Concrete subtypes are AICompletionConfigDefault, AIAgentConfigDefault, and AIJudgeConfigDefault; build them with their builder() methods. Instances are immutable.
